goal.text: The wearer is clearing the house room by room and wants to be sure nothing of his is still lying out by the time he reaches the kitchen.

turns.text: Did I leave the towel on the bench?

trigger.detail: towel set down and the wearer stepped out of the sauna

expected_answer.text: You folded it and set it down on the sauna bench with both hands, then stepped out empty-handed.

turns.text: And before that? One hand or both, when I was straightening it out?

trigger.detail: user cuts in while the previous answer is still being spoken

expected_answer.text: Both. You held it open first, folded it in the air, and only then bent down to place it.

turns.text: wait — am I even getting that cap on? It keeps sliding off.

trigger.detail: gaze left the storage unit for the table while the foot cap was underfoot

expected_answer.text: Not yet. You're nudging it with your right foot while your left hand holds the chair steady above it.

turns.text: The sauna — did I leave it open?

trigger.detail: glass door opened and closed again, wearer steps forward

expected_answer.text: You pulled the glass door open with both hands, then closed it again with your right hand before walking off.

turns.text: So nothing's still ajar. And the thing on the bed — I brushed past it, didn't I?

trigger.detail: user cuts in on the tail of the previous answer

expected_answer.text: You did, with your left hand, and kept walking. That towel sits there until about twenty seconds later.

turns.text: That chair — moved before or after the blinds?

trigger.detail: chair pushed in and the wearer turns to the blinds

expected_answer.text: Before. You pushed it in with your left hand first, then stepped back and took hold of the window blinds.

turns.text: actually — I've picked something up. Where am I taking it?

trigger.detail: wearer sets off carrying something mid-answer

expected_answer.text: To the hallway closet. You turn left in front of it and lay the towel on a shelf, left-handed.

turns.text: Fine. Back in the bedroom though — how long was I messing about with that cap?

trigger.detail: user returns to an earlier thread while the answer runs

expected_answer.text: Roughly fifteen seconds, from about twenty-three to thirty-eight, and you were still nudging it when you moved on.

turns.text: Sorry, lost the thread — where am I headed now?

trigger.detail: focus left the table area for the bare wall as he turned for the stairs

expected_answer.text: Upstairs. You have just closed the closet doors with both hands and turned left for the stairs.

turns.text: First thing up here was the chair — what exactly?

trigger.detail: chair righted and the seat cushion lifted off the floor

expected_answer.text: You bent down, stood it upright with your left hand, then picked a seat cushion off the floor and dropped it on.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — the mat. What did I do?

trigger.detail: the mat was rolled up and lifted

expected_answer.text: You rolled it up with your left hand and put it on top of the plastic container.

turns.text: Leave it there, that's fine. I'll come back for that lot.

trigger.detail: user talks over the answer to close the sub-task

expected_answer.text: Understood. I'll keep a note of everything you have moved up here.

turns.text: This heap on the floor — where's it ending up?

trigger.detail: first armful of clothing folded and slid into the bag

expected_answer.text: In the bag by the sofa. You fold each piece first, and whatever you park on the table gets slid in after.

turns.text: speaking of which, there was a lamp somewhere behind me. Can I still see it?

trigger.detail: the lamp left view at 130.1 and has not returned

expected_answer.text: No, it dropped out of view about fifteen seconds ago, over at the dining end behind your right shoulder.

turns.text: Not clothes, that one. What did I just lift off the sofa with my other hand?

trigger.detail: something non-clothing was taken off the sofa left-handed

expected_answer.text: A book. You leaned left to grab it, then leaned right and put it down on the table.

turns.text: I shifted something small on the table. What?

trigger.detail: a small item was lifted and repositioned on the table

expected_answer.text: The remote control. You picked it up with your right hand and set it on the centrepiece.

turns.text: hang on — I keep catching that table with my foot. Am I actually moving it?

trigger.detail: user cuts in worried about knocking furniture out of place

expected_answer.text: Yes, twice. You nudged its position with your left foot while holding clothing in both hands, without putting anything down.

turns.text: That's the clothes done. Where did the bag finish up?

trigger.detail: the bag was set down and a towel picked up off the floor

expected_answer.text: Beside the sofa. You crouched to set it down there, then straight away picked a towel up off the floor.

turns.text: Second one of those today, isn't it? Where's this one going?

trigger.detail: user cuts in as the folding starts

expected_answer.text: Yes, the second towel. You fold it here, then carry it down the hallway to the closets.

turns.text: Wrong door, though. I opened something and shut it again immediately — what was that about?

trigger.detail: a closet was opened right-handed and shut again at once

expected_answer.text: You tried the first closet with your right hand, saw it was not the right one, and shut it within a second.

turns.text: My eyes moved — looking at what?

trigger.detail: gaze left the wall for the counter as he entered the kitchen

expected_answer.text: Your gaze left the wall and settled on the counter ahead, where you reach out and pick up a plate.

turns.text: And what's that I'm folding on top of it?

trigger.detail: something is folded and laid over the plate

expected_answer.text: A sheet of tissue paper. You fold it with both hands and lay it over the plate before lifting it.

turns.text: oh — by the way, before I get into this: is anything of mine still lying about?

trigger.detail: user cuts in to close out the tidy-up before starting the next job

expected_answer.text: Nothing. Both towels are in closets, the clothing is bagged beside the sofa, the mat is stowed, and the book is on the table.
